guidance.heading: TPU, NBR or PVC?
guidance.body: TPU is the strongest choice: extruded through the jacket in one pass, it carries the highest pressures (up to 85 bar on concrete hose), resists abrasion when dragged and comes in the longest lengths. NBR (nitrile rubber) resists oil and fuel residue and is rated 10 bar in every size — a good all-round dewatering and discharge hose. PVC is the light, low-cost option for clean water at low pressure. Lay flat hose collapses under vacuum, so pump suction needs a rigid-helix suction hose.

items.a: A hose with a woven textile jacket and a polymer tube and cover that flattens when empty. It rolls onto a reel, deploys in long continuous lengths and takes far less space than round hose or pipe.

items.q: Can lay flat hose be used on pump suction?
items.a: No. It collapses under vacuum. Use a rigid-helix suction hose on the inlet and lay flat on the discharge.
Yes. We cut to length and fit Bauer, camlock, Storz, grooved or flanged couplings, banded or with expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose.

items.q: How do I size a lay flat line?
items.a: Choose the bore for the flow and allowable friction loss over the line length, then check that the hose's working pressure at that bore covers the pump's maximum pressure plus surge. Send us the flow, length and pump and we will size it.

products.title: TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose
products.focusKeyword: tpu lay flat well riser hose
products.descriptionShort: Lay flat TPU riser main for submersible borehole pumps: 1-1/4" to 10", working pressure 18 to 40 bar by size, tensile strength up to 60,900 kg. Supplied in long continuous lengths or as made-up assemblies with couplings fitted, from Indus Hydraulics in the UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
A flexible riser main for submersible pumps in boreholes and deep wells. The hose replaces rigid steel or uPVC drop pipe: it is lowered straight off a reel, carries the pump and the water column on its own tensile strength, and comes out again the same way for pump service. TPU does not corrode or scale, so it suits acidic or aggressive groundwater where steel column pipe pits and blocks.

Construction

  • Tube and cover: TPU, extruded through the jacket in one pass, so the layers cannot separate
  • Reinforcement: circular-woven high-tenacity polyester
  • Temperature: -50 °C to +80 °C
  • Colour: blue

Why lay flat in a well

  • One continuous length up to 400 m — no threaded joints to leak or loosen
  • Tensile strength up to 60,900 kg holds the pump and the full water column
  • Smooth TPU bore resists scaling and debris build-up
  • Installed and recovered with a hose reel or winding unit rather than a pipe-handling rig

Pressure and sizes

Working pressure runs from 40 bar at 1-1/4" to 18 bar at 10", with burst at 2.1 to 2.5 times working pressure. Size the hose on the pump's shut-off head plus any surge, not on duty head. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists bore, wall, weight, pressure and tensile strength for each of the 10 sizes.

Fittings

Riser hose is joined to the pump and the well head with dedicated stainless couplings that clamp onto the hose and carry the tensile load. We supply the couplings matched to the bore.

Installation and care

  • Unroll the hose fully and lay it out straight before pressurising; a hose pressurised on the reel or with twists can kink and burst.
  • Run it along the shortest practical route, away from sharp edges and hot surfaces, and protect it with hose ramps where vehicles cross.
  • Raise and lower pressure gradually. Closing a valve suddenly on a long line causes a surge that can exceed the working pressure.
  • Stay within the working pressure of the size in use; burst pressure is a test figure, never an operating limit.
  • After use, drain the hose, flush it if it carried slurry, fuel or concrete, and roll it flat from the far end to push out what is left.
  • Store coils out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects, and inspect the cover and coupling bands before each deployment.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the bore, the length you need, the fluid and the end connections. We supply bulk coils or made-up assemblies with couplings fitted and banded. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.answer: Depth is set by the hose's tensile strength against the weight of pump, hose and water, and by the pressure at the pump. Send the pump model, setting depth and shut-off head and we will confirm the size and class.

faqs.question: Why use lay flat hose instead of steel drop pipe?
faqs.answer: It does not corrode or scale, installs from a reel in one continuous length without joints, and comes out quickly for pump service. It suits acidic or alkaline groundwater and wells over about 60 m.

faqs.question: What lengths are available?
faqs.answer: Continuous lengths up to 400 m are made to order; 200 m and 400 m coils are the usual supply, and shorter cut lengths or assemblies are quoted on request. Long lengths mean fewer joints in a pipeline.

faqs.question: Can you supply it as a made-up assembly with couplings?
faqs.answer: Yes. We cut to length and fit the couplings you specify — Bauer, camlock, Storz, grooved or flanged ends — secured with bands or expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose. Tell us the length and both end connections.

faqs.question: How do I choose the bore?
faqs.answer: Pick the bore for the flow you need and the friction loss you can accept over the line length, then check that its working pressure covers the pump's maximum plus surge. Send us the flow, length and pump and we will size it.

products.title: EPDM/PE Suction Hose with Rigid Helix
products.descriptionShort: EPDM/PE suction and discharge hose with a rigid polyethylene helix, for the intake side of pumps feeding lay flat lines: 1" to 6", vacuum rated to 0.95 bar. Supplied in cut lengths up to 30 m or with camlock or threaded ends fitted, from Indus Hydraulics in the UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
The suction side of a lay flat system. Lay flat hose collapses under vacuum, so pumps draw through a hose with a rigid helix and discharge into lay flat. This EPDM/PE hose has a rigid polyethylene helix that holds it open at up to 0.95 bar vacuum, while staying light and flexible enough to handle by hand.

Construction

  • Hose wall: EPDM/PE compound, resistant to chemicals, abrasion and weather
  • Reinforcement: rigid polyethylene helix
  • Cold-resistant compound, stays flexible at low temperature
  • Colour: green with black helix

Applications

  • Vacuum and dewatering pump intakes
  • Frac fluid removal
  • Marine bilge discharge
  • Liquid fertiliser and manure handling
  • Irrigation pump suction

Ratings and sizes

Working pressure at 40 °C from 3.0 bar at 1" to 1.4 bar at 6"; vacuum at 40 °C 0.95 bar up to 2", 0.88 bar at 3" and 4", 0.81 bar at 6". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists bore, O.D., wall, weight and bend radius for all 7 sizes. Standard lengths up to 30 m.

Installation and care

  • Keep the suction line short and straight, and never bend it tighter than the minimum bend radius in the size table.
  • Fit a strainer or foot valve on the inlet sized to the pump's solids handling, so debris cannot block the hose or damage the pump.
  • Make every joint airtight: a small air leak on the suction side starves the pump and can make it lose prime.
  • Stay within the vacuum and working pressure listed at 40 °C; ratings fall as temperature rises.
  • Drain after use, flush it if it carried slurry or chemicals, and store it out of direct sunlight.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the bore, the length you need, the fluid and the end connections. We supply bulk coils or made-up assemblies with couplings fitted and banded. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

When to choose PVC

  • Clean water at low pressure
  • Temporary or seasonal lines where cost matters most
  • Light enough for one person to run out and roll up

For oily water, abrasive ground or higher pressure, choose the NBR or TPU lay flat hoses in this range.

Pressure and sizes

A per-size pressure table is not published for this hose. Tell us the bore, length and pump and we will confirm the rating before quoting.

Installation and care

  • Unroll the hose fully and lay it out straight before pressurising; a hose pressurised on the reel or with twists can kink and burst.
  • Run it along the shortest practical route, away from sharp edges and hot surfaces, and protect it with hose ramps where vehicles cross.
  • Raise and lower pressure gradually. Closing a valve suddenly on a long line causes a surge that can exceed the working pressure.
  • Stay within the working pressure of the size in use; burst pressure is a test figure, never an operating limit.
  • After use, drain the hose, flush it if it carried slurry, fuel or concrete, and roll it flat from the far end to push out what is left.
  • Store coils out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects, and inspect the cover and coupling bands before each deployment.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the bore, the length you need, the fluid and the end connections. We supply bulk coils or made-up assemblies with couplings fitted and banded. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
products.seoDescription: Lightweight, low-cost PVC lay flat hose for irrigation, construction pumps and temporary water transfer. Odourless, rolls flat, blue.

faqs.question: PVC, NBR or TPU lay flat?
faqs.answer: PVC is the lightest and lowest-cost choice for clean, low-pressure water. NBR adds oil and abrasion resistance at 10 bar; TPU gives the highest pressure, abrasion resistance and longest lengths.

faqs.question: What pressure is it rated for?
faqs.answer: PVC layflat is a low-pressure hose. A per-size table is not published; send the bore and pump and we will confirm before quoting.

faqs.question: Can you supply it as a made-up assembly with couplings?
faqs.answer: Yes. We cut to length and fit the couplings you specify — Bauer, camlock, Storz, grooved or flanged ends — secured with bands or expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose. Tell us the length and both end connections.

faqs.question: How do I choose the bore?
faqs.answer: Pick the bore for the flow you need and the friction loss you can accept over the line length, then check that its working pressure covers the pump's maximum plus surge. Send us the flow, length and pump and we will size it.

faqs.question: How should lay flat hose be stored?
faqs.answer: Drain and flush it, roll it flat from the far end, and store the coil out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects. Inspect the cover and coupling bands before each deployment.
